sn4.9:1.1: Evam me sutam ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || Tatra Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi || || Bhikkhavo ti || || Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagava to paccassosuṃ || || Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn4.9:2.1: Appam idam bhikkhave manussānam āyu || gamanīyo samparāyo || kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ || natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ || yo bhikkhave ciraṃ jīvati so vassasatam appam vā bhīyo ti || ||
sn4.9:3.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.9:4.1: Dīgham āyu manussānaṃ || na naṃ hīḷe suporiso || careyya khīramatto va || natthi maccussa āgamo ti || ||
sn4.9:5.1: Appam āyu manussānaṃ || hīḷeyya naṃ suporiso || careyyādittasīso va || natthi maccussa nāgamo ti
